declared_departures.what: POS 001 is selected before the newest-export-per-date rule, not after.
declared_departures.why: The run's order is equivalent on training data (POS 001 is the only till) but drops 12 dates in 2021 where the second till's export is newer.

declared_departures.what: Belgian public holidays computed for 2010-2024 instead of the run's range(2010, 2021).
declared_departures.why: Same Gregorian-Easter algorithm, more years. Verbatim replay flags zero holidays anywhere in the holdout, which would misprice every holiday closure.

declared_departures.what: Weather month-medians, competitor fills and lag/rolling NaN fills stay fitted on the run's own train rows (date <= 2018-10-04).
declared_departures.why: Refitting them over holdout rows would let holdout values reach the model's inputs.
